About the Role:
You’ll build the operating engine that helps our team turn global campaigns into regional pipeline for EMEA and LATAM. Sitting between global strategy and regional execution, you’ll adapt enterprise messaging and resources for regional buyers, then run, automate, and improve the work behind them: campaign setup, intake, localization, reporting, and follow-up.
This is a hands-on role. Roughly half your time goes to running regional activation and operations well. The other half goes to automating, templating, and improving that work as a core part of how the team operates. You will work closely with the Global Integrated Campaigns team, Field Marketing, Marketing Ops, EMEA/LATAM sales leadership, ADRs, Product Marketing & Partner Marketing.

What you'll be doing:
Regional activation and localization
• 
 Serve as the primary EMEA point of contact for the Growth Marketing teams (integrated campaigns, ABM, etc.), localizing company-wide programs for each sub-region and owning the regional campaign execution plan: goals, messaging angles, channel mix, and asset translation, all within brand standards.
• 
Help activate ADRs and Sales on localized campaigns.
Campaign and program execution
• 
Lead end-to-end local delivery across digital, email, social and ABM and collaborate with Field marketing on relevant industry events that are part of the overall campaigns. Manage timelines, vendors, and multi-channel coordination to hit regional pipeline targets.
• 
Build and launch campaigns and events hands-on in HubSpot (emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows) and Salesforce (campaign build-out, list pulls, segmentation), to Marketing Ops standards. Act as Marketing Ops' primary liaison for regional field marketing.
• 
Explore new vendors on behalf of the team and take them through Procurement.
Operating model and request intake
• 
Run the EMEA field marketing request intake: triage against priority tiers and SLAs, and route or decline work that doesn't fit the plan. Partner with marketing operations on behalf of field marketing to leverage use of AI automation.
• 
Design and maintain the localization workflow: translation tooling, a brand and terminology glossary, review routing, and vendor management.
• 
Translate global campaign strategy into modular playbooks and campaign kits that each region can adapt without rebuilding from scratch
Budget, performance, and insight
• 
Manage and forecast the regional campaign budget, and allocate it across channels and programs for maximum ROI.
• 
Define regional KPIs (MQLs, cost per MQL, pipeline influence, revenue impact). Own reporting and attribution hygiene across regions, including data quality in Salesforce and HubSpot.
• 
Measure the operational impact of your work: hours returned to the team, request cycle time, and campaign activation speed.
• 
Bring local market feedback on competitors, customer needs, and emerging opportunities to Product Marketing, Global Campaigns, and leadership.
• 
Partner with the Senior Field Marketing Managers to align the operating model with pipeline goals.
What you bring:
• 
Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
• 
7+ years in B2B marketing, field marketing, or program operations, ideally in B2B software. You have a record of running integrated, pipeline-focused programs.
• 
Hands-on experience as a Senior Field Marketing Manager (or equivalent regional field marketing role) running events, account-based campaigns, and sales partnership.
• 
Strong hands-on skills in Salesforce and HubSpot (or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform), including building campaigns and reporting on performance.
• 
Demonstrated experience building automations with workflow tools such as Claude and Zapier, or with scripting that connects systems. You know how to apply LLM tools to real operational work and where human review is required.
• 
Experience running multi-region programs, with an understanding of how regions and languages differ operationally.
• 
Strong program management: organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling many programs, vendors, and stakeholders at once.
• 
A process-oriented, analytical mindset. You document what you build, measure what it does, and use data (A/B testing, attribution) to improve it.
• 
Excellent written and verbal English. You can influence sales leaders, AEs, and senior marketers, and present to executives.
• 
You are self-motivated, outcome-focused, and comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
• 
Experience supporting field marketing or sales organizations in EMEA (LATAM a plus).
• 
Experience managing budgets over €500K.
Nice-to-haves:
• 
Experience with localization or translation management tools, or working with translation vendors.
• 
Fluency in a second European or Latin American language.
• 
Familiarity with ABM strategies and tools, and with event platforms and attendee data flows.
• 
Experience marketing to enterprise or technical buyers (developers, architects, platform teams), or a background in automation, orchestration, or workflow software.
• 
Experience mentoring a team.
What success looks like:
• 
First 90 days: You complete a time audit with the Senior Field Marketing Managers, launch request intake with defined tiers and SLAs, and automate at least two recurring processes.
• 
End of year one: The team is measurably faster on campaign launches. The Senior Field Marketing Managers spend more of their week on strategy and pipeline. You own a documented automation roadmap across EMEA and LATAM, and regional campaigns show a clear link to pipeline.
Why join us:
• 
Impact: Your campaigns and systems directly drive Camunda's growth in EMEA and LATAM, and you see your work in pipeline and revenue reports.
• 
Autonomy: Own execution, operations, and the automation roadmap for a high-growth region, with a collaborative global team behind you.
• 
Growth: Work with strong marketing leaders, build AI-driven ways of working, and develop expertise across complex, multicultural markets.
• 
Scale: Join a fast-growing company where your individual contribution shapes the trajectory in one of our most important regions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.

As a Sr. FP&A Analyst, you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.

Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis

What We Do
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.
We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are
Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.
Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.
The Role

We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team.

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team, primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale.

You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team.

Responsibilities

Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)
• 
Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity.
• 
Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.
• 
Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.
• 
Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.
• 
Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

Run your own sales cycles (~25%)
• 
Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.
• 
Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.
• 
Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

Inform product and build for scale
• 
Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization.
• 
Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed.
• 
Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths.
• 
Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates.

Qualifications
• 
2+ years managing or formally mentoring pre-sales, solutions consulting or sales engineering teams, with a track record of developing people.
• 
3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation.
• 
3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions.
• 
Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.
• 
Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment.
• 
Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.
• 
Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail.
• 
CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet
• 
Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.
• 
Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.
• 
Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

As a Senior PreSales Engineer, you'll demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations across EMEA with a focus on German Government and Commercial B2B to overcome their earth data challenges. Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Descript is at an inflection point. We have 50M+ users, genuine product-market fit, and a real opportunity to move upmarket—converting high-fit self-serve users into consolidated enterprise contracts and going after the accounts that belong in our pipeline. As Head of Enterprise Marketing, you'll own that motion end-to-end.

This is a builder role for someone who's done it before: someone who can meticulously understand what's driving inbound interest, identify which accounts to go after and why, and design the campaigns, lifecycle plays, and conversion experiments to bring them in. You'll co-own upmarket pipeline with Sales, partner with Product on the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion, and partner with our in-house Growth/Paid team and RevOps to make sure the whole system is instrumented and accountable.

The raw materials are here—a passionate user community, a strong product, and a large market. This hire shapes what we do with them upmarket.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline Strategy & Execution

• Co-own upmarket pipeline targets with Sales, with shared accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline

• Build and execute an enterprise demand playbook: ICP definition, target account selection, channel mix, offer strategy, and campaign design and execution

• Develop a vertical prioritization framework: define which industries and enterprise segments to pursue, in what order, and with what message

• Design account-based programs with messaging and experiences calibrated to high-fit accounts

• Own and maintain an annual marketing calendar that aligns campaign activity to business milestones, seasonal growth opportunities, and pipeline targets

• Source and manage contract and agency resources as needed

Self-Serve to Enterprise Conversion

• Partner with Product and Sales to identify high-fit self-serve buyers and design conversion experiments that move them toward consolidated contracts

• Build lifecycle plays that nurture individual users into team and enterprise buyers

• Develop and iterate on the plays, offers, and sequences that convert product-qualified accounts into pipeline

Performance & Measurement

• Meticulously track which channels, plays, and offers are driving inbound interest and conversions, and use that intelligence to sharpen programs continuously

• Build AI-first marketing ops and measurement frameworks that give the team real visibility into what's working

• Report regularly on pipeline contribution, channel efficiency, and program performance

Sales & Cross-functional Partnership

• Partner daily with Sales on account priorities, ABM strategy, and pipeline reviews

• Brief and align with the in-house paid advertising team on enterprise-targeted campaigns

• Co-own enterprise lifecycle with RevOps, ensuring accountability is clear and programs are coordinated

• Own the strategy for high-touch deal acceleration programs—things like executive roundtables and leadership-level events—partnering with Field Marketing on execution

• Contribute to enterprise pricing and packaging strategy alongside Product and Sales, with an eye toward what moves deals forward and expands accounts

WHAT YOU BRING

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 years building or scaling an upmarket or enterprise demand motion

• Experience at a PLG or product-led company—you understand the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion and have driven it

• Consumer-to-B2B crossover experience; you know how to market to users who are also buyers

• Strong analytical skills and a track record of building measurement frameworks that actually get used

• Experience co-owning pipeline targets with Sales in an accountable, collaborative way

Preferred Qualifications

• Deep familiarity with modern ABM tooling and CRM/MAP integration

• Experience building, or deeply partnering with, AI-native marketing ops and workflows

• Background in SaaS, media tech, or creative tooling

• Demonstrated ability to design and run conversion experiments across PLG funnels

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Within your first 12 months, you will:

• Launch Descript's enterprise demand motion, with a defined ICP, target account list, vertical prioritization framework, and multi-channel playbook

• Co-own and hit upmarket pipeline targets in partnership with Sales

• Build upon the existing self-serve-to-enterprise conversion experiments with Product, with measurable account progression

• Build a measurement framework that gives the team clear visibility into channel performance, conversion rates, and pipeline attributionCreate and maintain a formal marketing calendar that the broader team runs off of

• Establish a functioning enterprise lifecycle program with RevOps

• Run at least one high-touch deal acceleration program (EBC, roundtable, or CxO event) in partnership with Field Marketing

The base salary range for this role is $180k - $230k/year. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

About Descript

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital). 

Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.  For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.  For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. We do believe there are valuable and serendipitous moments of discovery and collaboration that come from working together in person. 

Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We believe in actively building a team rich in diverse backgrounds, experiences, and opinions to better allow our employees, products, and community to thrive.
